tools.name: get_script_format
tools.description: Returns the full guide for writing a VibeCreator video script (one JSON object): fields, rules, places, poses, emotions, kinds of video and visual styles.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: Lists the visual styles a video can use (id, name, look and what it is good for).

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Checks a script written in the VibeCreator format and returns a link that opens it as an animated video in the user's browser, where they can preview it, edit every part and export the MP4. The video is built from the script by code; no image or video model is used and nothing is stored.
